Bengaluru experiences overnight rain, temperatures drop

Bengaluru recorded overnight rainfall, with the Kempegowda International Airport (KIA) weather station registering 94.2 mm of rain. The precipitation brought down temperatures that had been above 30°C for the preceding two weeks.
